itinerary.title: Mumbai → Jeddah · Perform Umrah

itinerary.title: Days 2–5 · Ibadah in Makkah
itinerary.text: Five daily prayers in Masjid al-Haram, nafl Tawaf and Qur’an recitation, with short talks by the group leader on the virtues and etiquette of the Haram.

itinerary.title: Day 6 · Makkah Ziarat

itinerary.title: Day 7 · Ibadah · Tawaf al-Wida

itinerary.title: Day 8 · Makkah → Madinah
itinerary.text: Travel to Madinah by AC coach (Haramain train on request) and check in near Masjid an-Nabawi.

itinerary.title: Days 9–13 · Masjid an-Nabawi & Rawdah
itinerary.text: Prayers at the Prophet’s Mosque ﷺ, Salam at the Rawdah (Nusuk appointment booked for you) and visits to Jannat al-Baqi.

itinerary.title: Day 14 · Madinah Ziarat
itinerary.text: Guided Ziarat: Masjid Quba, Mount Uhud and the martyrs’ graveyard, Masjid al-Qiblatain, the site of the Battle of the Trench and a date farm.

itinerary.title: Day 15 · Return to Mumbai
itinerary.text: Transfer to Madinah (or Jeddah) airport for the flight home with your Zamzam allowance.

A passport valid for at least 6 months, a recent white-background photo and any vaccination certificate required at the time of travel. We complete the visa and Nusuk registration for you.

Yes. Hotel category, distance from the Haram and room sharing (quad / triple / double) can all be changed — ask us for the upgraded price.

packages.title: Mesmerizing Kashmir
packages.imageAlt: Houseboat on Dal Lake with snow-capped mountains, Srinagar
packages.summary: 5 Nights / 6 Days — Pahalgam (2) – Gulmarg (1) – Srinagar (2) with breakfast & dinner, all sightseeing, transportation, accommodation and a tour guide.
packages.overview: Six days through the three classic corners of the Kashmir valley: the Lidder river valleys of Pahalgam, the meadows and Gondola of Gulmarg, and Srinagar’s Mughal Gardens and Dal Lake. A private vehicle and guide stay with you throughout, with breakfast and dinner every day.
highlights: Betaab Valley, Aru Valley & Chandanwari, Pahalgam
Saffron fields of Pampore and Awantipora ruins
Gulmarg meadows and the Gondola (ticket extra)
Mughal Gardens — Nishat, Shalimar & Chashme Shahi

itinerary.title: Arrive Srinagar → Pahalgam
itinerary.text: Arrive at Srinagar airport and drive about 3 hours to Pahalgam, stopping at the saffron fields of Pampore and the Awantipora ruins. Evening walk along the Lidder river.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Valleys
itinerary.text: Full day in Pahalgam: Betaab Valley, Aru Valley and Chandanwari (local union cab, paid directly). Optional pony ride to Baisaran meadow.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam → Gulmarg
itinerary.text: Drive to Gulmarg, the ‘meadow of flowers’. Afternoon free to ride the Gulmarg Gondola (Phase 1/2, ticket extra) or enjoy snow activities in season.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg → Srinagar · Shikara Ride
itinerary.text: Drive back to Srinagar. Check in and take a shikara ride on Dal Lake past the floating gardens and Char Chinar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar · Mughal Gardens
itinerary.text: Visit Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh and Chashme Shahi, and the Hazratbal Shrine. Evening free for shopping for dry fruits, pashmina and handicrafts.

itinerary.title: Depart Srinagar
itinerary.text: Transfer to Srinagar airport for your flight home.

exclusions: Airfare / train fare to the starting point
Entry tickets, camera fees and adventure activities unless mentioned
Local union cabs in Pahalgam and Gondola tickets
packages.bestTime: March to October for meadows; December to February for snow
faqs: Is airfare included in Mesmerizing Kashmir?
No. The package covers stay, meals, sightseeing, transport and a guide. We book flights to Srinagar separately at the best available fare.
When is snow in Gulmarg?
Usually December to March; Gondola Phase 2 often has snow until May.

packages.title: Magnificent Kerala
packages.imageAlt: Traditional houseboat on the palm-lined backwaters of Alleppey
packages.summary: 7 Nights / 8 Days — Munnar (2) – Thekkady (1) – Alleppey (1) – Kovalam (2) – Cochin (1) with accommodation, meals, all sightseeing, transportation and a houseboat in Alleppey.
packages.overview: The complete Kerala circuit in eight days: tea-covered hills in Munnar, spice gardens and wildlife in Thekkady, a night aboard a private houseboat on the Alleppey backwaters, beach days at Kovalam and the old port town of Cochin.
highlights: Tea gardens, Mattupetty Dam & Eravikulam National Park, Munnar
Spice plantation tour and Periyar Lake, Thekkady
Overnight private houseboat cruise in Alleppey
Fort Kochi, Chinese fishing nets & Jew Town

itinerary.title: Arrive Cochin → Munnar
itinerary.text: Arrive at Cochin airport and drive about 4 hours into the hills, stopping at the Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Eravikulam National Park (home of the Nilgiri tahr), the Tea Museum, Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point and the rolling tea estates.

itinerary.title: Munnar → Thekkady
itinerary.text: Drive to Thekkady. Visit a spice plantation and, in the evening, see a Kathakali or Kalaripayattu show (optional).

itinerary.title: Thekkady → Alleppey · Houseboat
itinerary.text: Optional boat ride on Periyar Lake, then drive to Alleppey and board your private houseboat for a cruise through the backwaters and village canals. Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: Alleppey → Kovalam
itinerary.text: Disembark after breakfast and drive to Kovalam. Evening on Lighthouse Beach.

itinerary.title: Kovalam & Trivandrum

items: Flight Hanoi → Ho Chi Minh City

itinerary.title: Cu Chi Tunnels · City Tour
itinerary.text: Morning at the Cu Chi Tunnels; afternoon city tour — Notre-Dame Cathedral, Central Post Office and Ben Thanh market.

itinerary.title: Mekong Delta
itinerary.text: Day trip to the Mekong Delta — boat ride through the canals, fruit orchards and a coconut-candy workshop.

itinerary.title: Depart
itinerary.text: Transfer to Tan Son Nhat airport for your flight home.

inclusions: Ha Long Bay overnight cruise with meals on board
exclusions: Airfare (we quote the best fare for your dates separately)
Domestic flight Hanoi → Ho Chi Minh City
faqs: Do Indians need a visa for Vietnam?
Yes — an e-visa, usually issued within a few working days. We apply for you.
Is airfare included?
No — international and domestic flights are quoted separately at the best available fare.

packages.summary: 3 Nights / 4 Days — Da Nang (2) – Hoi An (1) with accommodation, breakfast, all sightseeing and transportation.
packages.overview: A short, romantic Vietnam escape: the Golden Bridge and French Village at Ba Na Hills, Da Nang’s beaches and Marble Mountains, and a lantern-lit night in the UNESCO old town of Hoi An.
highlights: Ba Na Hills & the Golden Bridge by cable car
Hoi An Ancient Town & Japanese Covered Bridge
Lantern boat ride on the Thu Bon river

itinerary.title: Arrive Da Nang
itinerary.text: Arrive at Da Nang airport and transfer to the hotel near My Khe beach. Evening at the Dragon Bridge.

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge
itinerary.text: Cable car up to Ba Na Hills for the Golden Bridge, the French Village and Fantasy Park.

itinerary.title: Marble Mountains → Hoi An
itinerary.text: Visit the Marble Mountains and Lady Buddha at Son Tra, then transfer to Hoi An for a walking tour and a lantern boat ride at night.

itinerary.title: Depart
itinerary.text: Transfer to Da Nang airport for your flight home.

exclusions: Airfare (we quote the best fare for your dates separately)
faqs: Do Indians need a visa for Vietnam?
Yes — an e-visa, usually issued within a few working days. We apply for you.
Is airfare included?
No — international and domestic flights are quoted separately at the best available fare.

packages.title: Dubai Luxury
packages.imageAlt: Burj Al Arab on the Jumeirah coast
gallery: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque reflected in a pool, Abu Dhabi
packages.summary: 5 Nights / 6 Days — Dubai (4) – Yas Island (1) with accommodation, breakfast, all sightseeing, desert safari, cruise dinner and transportation.
packages.overview: Dubai in style for four nights — city tour, Burj Khalifa, desert safari and a Marina cruise dinner — then a night on Abu Dhabi’s Yas Island with the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque on the way.
highlights: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Abu Dhabi
Yas Island — Ferrari World / Yas Waterworld (optional)

itinerary.title: Arrive Dubai · Cruise Dinner
itinerary.text: Arrive and transfer to the hotel. Evening dhow cruise dinner along Dubai Marina.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour · Burj Khalifa
itinerary.text: Half-day city tour, then Burj Khalifa ‘At the Top’ and the Dubai Fountain show.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.text: Morning free; afternoon desert safari with dune bashing, camel ride and BBQ dinner.

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure
itinerary.text: Free day for Dubai Mall, the Museum of the Future or a spa.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi · Yas Island
itinerary.text: Drive to Abu Dhabi, visit the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, then check in on Yas Island. Optional Ferrari World or Yas Waterworld.

itinerary.title: Depart
itinerary.text: Transfer to Abu Dhabi or Dubai airport for your flight home.

exclusions: Airfare (we quote the best fare for your dates separately)
faqs: Can we add Ferrari World or Yas Waterworld?
Yes — theme-park tickets can be added at the current price.
Is the UAE visa included?
We process the UAE tourist visa for you at the prevailing fee.

packages.title: Kashmir Escape
packages.imageAlt: Shikara on Dal Lake with mountains behind, Srinagar
gallery: Wildflowers and a house on a Kashmir hillside
packages.summary: 4 Nights / 5 Days — Srinagar (4) with breakfast + dinner, all sightseeing, transportation, accommodation and a tour guide.
packages.overview: Stay four nights in Srinagar — including a houseboat night on Dal Lake — and see Gulmarg, Pahalgam and Sonamarg on day trips, without changing hotels.

itinerary.title: Arrive Srinagar · Shikara
itinerary.text: Arrive at Srinagar airport and check in to a houseboat. Sunset shikara ride on Dal Lake.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Day Trip
itinerary.text: Day trip to Gulmarg for the meadows and the Gondola (ticket extra).

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Day Trip
itinerary.text: Day trip to Pahalgam via the Pampore saffron fields; Betaab Valley by local cab.

itinerary.title: Sonamarg Day Trip
itinerary.text: Drive along the Sindh river to Sonamarg, the ‘meadow of gold’, with an optional pony ride to the Thajiwas glacier.

itinerary.title: Mughal Gardens · Depart
itinerary.text: Visit Nishat and Shalimar Bagh before your transfer to the airport.

exclusions: Airfare / train fare to the starting point
Entry tickets, camera fees and adventure activities unless mentioned
Local union cabs, ponies and Gondola tickets
packages.bestTime: March to October; December to February for snow
faqs: Is there a houseboat stay in Kashmir Escape?
Yes — the first night is on a deluxe houseboat on Dal Lake.
Is airfare included?
No — flights to Srinagar are quoted separately.

packages.title: Seaside Kerala
packages.imageAlt: Houseboat on the Alleppey backwaters
gallery: Boat silhouette at sunset in Kerala
packages.summary: 4 Nights / 5 Days — Cochin (1) – Alleppey (1) – Kovalam (2) with accommodation, meals, all sightseeing, transportation and a houseboat in Alleppey.
packages.overview: Kerala’s coast for couples: Fort Kochi’s heritage lanes, a private overnight houseboat on the backwaters, and two beach nights in Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Arrive Cochin
itinerary.text: Arrive at Cochin airport. Afternoon tour of Fort Kochi — Chinese fishing nets, St Francis Church and Jew Town.

itinerary.title: Cochin → Alleppey Houseboat
itinerary.text: Drive to Alleppey and board a private houseboat for a cruise through the backwaters. Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: Alleppey → Kovalam
itinerary.text: Disembark and drive to Kovalam. Evening on Lighthouse Beach.

itinerary.title: Kovalam & Trivandrum
itinerary.text: Trivandrum city tour and optional Poovar backwater cruise; rest of the day at the beach.

itinerary.title: Depart Trivandrum
itinerary.text: Transfer to Trivandrum airport for your flight home.

inclusions: Meals (breakfast & dinner; all meals on the houseboat)
exclusions: Airfare / train fare to the starting point
Entry tickets, camera fees and adventure activities unless mentioned
faqs: Is the houseboat private for couples?
Yes — a private one-bedroom houseboat with crew and all meals on board.
Where does the tour end?
At Trivandrum airport, about 30 minutes from Kovalam.

packages.title: Thrilling Karnataka
packages.imageAlt: Cloud-covered green hills of Coorg
packages.summary: 5 Nights / 6 Days — Coorg (3) – Mysore (2) with breakfast + dinner, all sightseeing, transportation, accommodation and a tour guide.
packages.overview: Coffee estates, waterfalls and misty hills in Coorg, then the palaces and gardens of royal Mysore — an easy, romantic South India getaway.

itinerary.title: Arrive Bangalore → Coorg
itinerary.text: Pick-up from Bangalore (or Mangalore) and drive to Coorg. Evening at leisure at your resort.

itinerary.title: Coorg Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Abbey Falls, Omkareshwara Temple, Madikeri Fort and sunset at Raja’s Seat.

itinerary.title: Dubare & Bylakuppe
itinerary.text: Dubare Elephant Camp, Nisargadhama island and the Namdroling Golden Temple at Bylakuppe.

itinerary.title: Coorg → Mysore
itinerary.text: Drive to Mysore. Evening at Brindavan Gardens for the musical fountain show.

itinerary.title: Mysore Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Mysore Palace, Chamundi Hills, St Philomena’s Church and Devaraja market.

itinerary.title: Depart
itinerary.text: Drive to Bangalore airport for your flight home (via Srirangapatna).

exclusions: Airfare / train fare to the starting point
Entry tickets, camera fees and adventure activities unless mentioned
faqs: Where does the Karnataka tour start?
From Bangalore (or Mangalore on request), with a private vehicle throughout.
Is river rafting included?
Rafting at Dubare is seasonal and optional, paid directly.

packages.title: Manali Getaway
packages.imageAlt: Sun over snowy mountains near Manali
packages.summary: 3 Nights / 4 Days — Manali (3) with breakfast + dinner, all sightseeing, transportation, accommodation and a tour guide.
packages.overview: Three nights in Manali with Solang Valley snow, the Atal Tunnel and the old temples and cafés of Old Manali.
highlights: Solang Valley — ropeway, paragliding & snow activities

itinerary.title: Arrive Manali
itinerary.text: Arrive by overnight Volvo from Delhi or flight to Bhuntar and transfer to the hotel. Evening on Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley & Atal Tunnel
itinerary.text: Day trip to Solang Valley and through the Atal Tunnel to Sissu (Rohtang on permit).

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Hadimba Temple, Vashisht hot springs, Tibetan monastery, Club House and Old Manali cafés.

itinerary.title: Depart Manali
itinerary.text: Transfer to the Volvo stand or Bhuntar airport.

exclusions: Airfare / train fare to the starting point
Entry tickets, camera fees and adventure activities unless mentioned
Rohtang permit, Solang activities & local union cabs
packages.bestTime: March to June; December to February for snow
faqs: How do we reach Manali from Mumbai?
Fly to Delhi or Chandigarh and take an overnight Volvo, or fly to Bhuntar (Kullu). We can book any of these.
Will there be snow?
Snow is likely at Solang and Atal Tunnel from December to April.

packages.title: Incredible Goa
packages.imageAlt: Blue sea under a sunny sky in Goa
gallery: Colourful beach huts and palms in Goa
Beach umbrellas on a Goa beach
packages.summary: 3 Nights / 4 Days with breakfast + dinner, all sightseeing, transportation, accommodation and a tour guide.
packages.overview: Beaches, forts and old churches in a long weekend: North Goa’s beaches and Fort Aguada, South Goa’s churches and Colva, and a sunset cruise on the Mandovi.
highlights: North Goa — Calangute, Baga & Anjuna beaches
Basilica of Bom Jesus, Old Goa

itinerary.title: Arrive Goa
itinerary.text: Arrive at Goa airport or Madgaon/Thivim station and transfer to the hotel. Evening at the beach.

itinerary.title: North Goa Tour
itinerary.text: Fort Aguada, Calangute, Baga, Anjuna and Vagator beaches and Chapora Fort.

itinerary.title: South Goa Tour · River Cruise
itinerary.text: Old Goa churches (Basilica of Bom Jesus, Se Cathedral), Mangueshi Temple, Dona Paula, Miramar and Colva beaches; evening Mandovi river cruise.

itinerary.title: Depart Goa
itinerary.text: Transfer to the airport or station for your journey home.

exclusions: Airfare / train fare to the starting point
Entry tickets, camera fees and adventure activities unless mentioned
faqs: Is Incredible Goa good for a short honeymoon?
Yes — 3 nights with both North and South Goa covered and free evenings for the beach.
Can we travel by train from Mumbai?
Yes — we arrange pick-up from Madgaon or Thivim station as well as the airport.

packages.title: Wonders of Himachal
packages.imageAlt: Shimla town on the hills under a blue sky
packages.summary: 5 Nights / 6 Days — Shimla (2) – Manali (3) with breakfast + dinner, all sightseeing, transportation, accommodation and a tour guide.
packages.overview: Himachal’s two favourite hill stations: colonial Shimla with Kufri, then three nights in Manali with Solang Valley and the Atal Tunnel.
highlights: Mall Road, the Ridge & Christ Church, Shimla

itinerary.title: Arrive Chandigarh → Shimla
itinerary.text: Pick-up from Chandigarh and drive to Shimla. Evening on Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Kufri & Shimla
itinerary.text: Excursion to Kufri, then Jakhoo Temple and Christ Church.

itinerary.title: Shimla → Manali
itinerary.text: Drive to Manali through the Kullu valley (optional rafting).

itinerary.title: Solang Valley & Atal Tunnel
itinerary.text: Day trip to Solang Valley and through the Atal Tunnel to Sissu.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Hadimba Temple, Vashisht hot springs, monastery and Old Manali.

itinerary.title: Depart
itinerary.text: Drive back to Chandigarh for your onward journey.

exclusions: Airfare / train fare to the starting point
Entry tickets, camera fees and adventure activities unless mentioned
Rohtang permit, Solang activities & local union cabs
packages.bestTime: March to June; December to February for snow
faqs: Where does Wonders of Himachal start?
At Chandigarh airport or railway station, and it ends there too.
Can we add Dharamshala?
Yes — see our Grand Himachal with Amritsar package, or ask us to customise.

packages.title: Char Dham Yatra
packages.imageAlt: Kedarnath Temple in the Himalayas
gallery: Badrinath town by the Alaknanda river
packages.summary: 10 Nights / 11 Days — Haridwar – Barkot – Uttarkashi – Guptkashi – Badrinath – Rudraprayag – Haridwar with accommodation, all sightseeing, breakfast + dinner, transportation and helicopter service to Kedarnath.
packages.overview: The complete Char Dham Yatra of Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath from Haridwar, with the Kedarnath leg by helicopter to save the long trek.
highlights: Ganga aarti at Har Ki Pauri, Haridwar

itinerary.title: Arrive Haridwar
itinerary.text: Pick-up from Dehradun airport or Haridwar station. Evening Ganga aarti at Har Ki Pauri.

itinerary.title: Haridwar → Barkot
itinerary.text: Drive via Mussoorie and Kempty Falls to Barkot.

itinerary.title: Yamunotri Darshan
itinerary.text: Drive to Janki Chatti and trek (or pony/palki, extra) about 6 km to Yamunotri for darshan; return to Barkot.

itinerary.title: Barkot → Uttarkashi
itinerary.text: Drive to Uttarkashi; visit the Kashi Vishwanath temple.

itinerary.title: Gangotri Darshan
itinerary.text: Day trip to Gangotri via Harsil for darshan; return to Uttarkashi.

itinerary.title: Uttarkashi → Guptkashi
itinerary.text: Long scenic drive to Guptkashi along the Mandakini river.

itinerary.title: Kedarnath by Helicopter
itinerary.text: Transfer to the helipad (Phata/Sersi/Guptkashi) and fly to Kedarnath for darshan; return by helicopter the same day.

itinerary.title: Guptkashi → Badrinath
itinerary.text: Drive to Badrinath via Joshimath. Evening darshan and Tapt Kund.

itinerary.title: Mana Village → Rudraprayag
itinerary.text: Morning darshan, then Mana village (Vyas Gufa, Bhim Pul) and drive to Rudraprayag.

itinerary.title: Rudraprayag → Haridwar
itinerary.text: Drive back via Devprayag (confluence of the Alaknanda and Bhagirathi) and Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Depart Haridwar
itinerary.text: Transfer to Dehradun airport or Haridwar station.

exclusions: Airfare / train fare to the starting point
Entry tickets, camera fees and adventure activities unless mentioned
packages.bestTime: May to June and September to October (temples open late April/May to November)
faqs: Is the Kedarnath helicopter guaranteed?
Helicopter tickets are issued through the official IRCTC/UCADA system and depend on weather; we book as early as the window opens.
Is registration required for Char Dham?
Yes — Uttarakhand tourism registration is mandatory for every pilgrim; we complete it for you.

packages.title: Golden Triangle Tour
packages.imageAlt: The Taj Mahal, Agra
packages.summary: 2N Delhi – 1N Agra – 3N Jaipur / Ajmer Sharif Dargah with breakfast + dinner, all sightseeing, transportation, accommodation and a tour guide.
packages.overview: India’s classic Golden Triangle — Delhi, Agra and Jaipur — with a day of ziyarat at the Dargah of Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti in Ajmer Sharif.
highlights: Jama Masjid, Red Fort & Qutub Minar, Delhi
Ajmer Sharif Dargah & Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra

itinerary.title: Arrive Delhi
itinerary.text: Arrive in Delhi and check in. Evening visit to Hazrat Nizamuddin Dargah for the qawwali.

itinerary.title: Delhi Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Jama Masjid, Red Fort (outside), Chandni Chowk, Raj Ghat, India Gate, Humayun’s Tomb and Qutub Minar.

itinerary.title: Delhi → Agra · Taj Mahal
itinerary.text: Drive to Agra by expressway. Visit the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort.

itinerary.title: Fatehpur Sikri → Jaipur
itinerary.text: Visit Fatehpur Sikri, the Jama Masjid and Salim Chishti’s tomb, then drive to Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Jaipur Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Amer Fort, Jal Mahal, City Palace, Jantar Mantar and Hawa Mahal.

itinerary.title: Ajmer Sharif Day Trip
itinerary.text: Drive about 2.5 hours to Ajmer for ziyarat at the Dargah of Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti and the Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra mosque; return to Jaipur.

itinerary.title: Depart Jaipur
itinerary.text: Transfer to Jaipur airport or station.

exclusions: Airfare / train fare to the starting point
Entry tickets, camera fees and adventure activities unless mentioned
faqs: Does the Golden Triangle tour include Ajmer Sharif?
Yes — a full day trip from Jaipur to the Dargah of Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti.
Is the Taj Mahal open every day?
The Taj Mahal is closed on Fridays, so we plan the Agra day around it.
